tasks.short: Compare cost and benefit of water construction schemes.

steps.what: Measure construction quantities for the treatment plants.
Apply the benefit and construction price table.
Judge which benefit case is credible for this water.
Finance colleague checks the construction price lines.
Present the cost-benefit analyses to the sponsor.

tasks.design: Quantities from the design are priced in {SPREADSHEET} from a table, then a colleague checks the lines in {ERP}. The engineer still judges which benefit is credible and presents that case. Nothing is presented until the engineer has tied the case to the cost sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantities were remeasured into a new workbook for every scheme, and benefits were a paragraph.
tasks.enabler_now: Quantity times price is a formula. Which benefit is real stays a judgement, and the presentation stays a meeting.
tasks.still_hard: A benefit that is large on paper and will not be paid or permitted.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which damage the scheme actually avoids.

ambition.what: Stop a scheme whose priced cost beats the credible benefit before the sponsor meeting, instead of discovering it in the room.

tasks.altitude: Sponsor meetings stay. The engineer can decline to present a case that is not on the cost sheet.

reach.task: Estimate civil quantities for tanks, channels and excavation
reach.learn: Which quantities the price table double-counts if the drawing is incomplete

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
A cost estimate is quantities times a price table; the benefit case is not that multiplication.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from design quantities to the sponsor presentation. Funding approval by the sponsor is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas and the {ERP} price source before custom code.
Structured fields are item, quantity, unit price, benefit name and benefit amount. The drawing produces quantities. Fallback: a missing quantity is entered by the engineer and marked estimated.
The sponsor meeting is not a dashboard.
unknowns: Which benefits the sponsor will accept as money.
research_questions: Which schemes have a benefit that cannot be priced?

already_counted.description: Judging benefit cases the price table does not prove

incremental.description: Refresh the price table when rates change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A scheme with measured quantities saves the takeoff and the price pass. The benefit judgement and the sponsor meeting stay. The low case is a scheme with no agreed prices.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer government agencies on water resource or treatment issues.

steps.what: Read the government agency question on treatment.

loop.output: Question note: site, parameter, date and what is asked
loop.check: Engineer checks the note against the question
loop.stop: One pass; an unclear ask stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Agency questions are prose, not a form

steps.what: Pull the treatment record that answers the question.
Explain the treatment issues to the government agency.
Send the checked support note to the agency.

loop.input: Meeting notes and the answer facts
loop.output: Support note that restates the question and the figures used
loop.check: Engineer checks every figure against the record before send
loop.stop: One draft; a figure not in the record is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow what was told to the agency, not a template answer

tasks.design: The agency question is split into site, parameter and ask, and the matching treatment record is pulled from {DOCS} or the {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer still explains the issue in the meeting. The written note is sent only after every figure is checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each agency question meant a search through mail and a rewritten answer.
tasks.enabler_now: A structured question can find the record. Explaining it to the agency stays a conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Answering when the record and what the agency believes do not match.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer hears the real concern and does not send a figure that would mislead the agency.
tasks.altitude: Agency conversations stay the bulk of this work. The engineer can refuse to send a note that adds a figure the record does not hold.

reach.task: Explain a structural limit to a permitting agency
reach.learn: Which answers the agency treats as a commitment

evidence.claim: The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Finding a record for a question is a lookup; advising an agency is not.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from an agency question to the sent support note. Changing the plant is out of scope.
Test {DOCS} search and the {OPS_SYSTEM} export before custom code.
Structured fields are site, parameter, date and record value. The plant record produces the value. Fallback: the engineer types a value from paper and marks it unchecked.
The meeting with the agency stays.
unknowns: Whether the agency expects a formal filing or a note.
Who may speak for the client.
research_questions: Which questions need a new calculation rather than a record?

already_counted.description: Editing the support note against the record
Resolving questions the extract leaves unclear

incremental.description: Keep site names aligned with the agency's names

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A question that names a site and a parameter saves the search. The explanation and the sent wording stay. The low case is a question the record does not answer.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study whether a water facility is feasible to build.

steps.what: Collect land and permit constraints for the feasibility studies.

loop.output: Constraint list: type, limit and source page
loop.check: Engineer checks each constraint against the page
loop.stop: One pass; a constraint without a page is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Permit excerpts are prose, not a constraint register

steps.what: Test whether supply systems meet the forecast demand.
Outline construction cost for the feasible facilities.
Walk the site named in the feasibility studies.
Judge if the feasibility studies support construction.
Issue the feasibility studies for decision.

loop.input: Judgement, site notes and cost outline
loop.output: Feasibility issue stating build, do not build, or missing fact
loop.check: Engineer checks the stated cost and capacity against the sheets
loop.stop: One draft; a conclusion the judgement did not reach is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue must match the site notes, not only the capacity sheet

tasks.design: Constraints are listed from the site file, and capacity and an outline cost are calculated in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer still judges whether that supports construction and walks the site. The study is issued only after the conclusion is checked against those sheets.
tasks.previous_blocker: Every feasibility study restated the same constraints and rebuilt the same capacity sum.
tasks.enabler_now: Capacity and outline cost can be calculated from fields. The build-or-not judgement and the walk stay.
tasks.still_hard: A scheme that passes capacity and fails on a constraint seen only on site.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not call a site feasible after walking a constraint the file missed.

ambition.what: Return an infeasible result as soon as a hard constraint fails, before a full study is staffed.

tasks.altitude: Site walks stay on feasible-looking schemes. The engineer can issue a stop when a hard constraint is already evidenced.

reach.task: Test whether a building fits the same site constraint
reach.learn: Which land constraints apply to structures as well as to process units

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from site and permit constraints to the issued feasibility conclusion. Detailed design is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas before custom code.

Structured fields are constraint type, limit, source page, demand, capacity and outline cost. The site file produces constraints. Fallback: the engineer types a constraint found on the walk and marks it unverified in the file.
The site walk is not optional when the file is incomplete.
The feasibility issue is approved only after the site walk. The approval is the post-walk judgement, not the desk sheets.
unknowns: Which constraints the client treats as hard.
Whether outline prices are allowed in a feasibility issue.
research_questions: Which schemes need a ground investigation before any feasibility conclusion?

already_counted.description: Judging build or stop after the site walk

incremental.description: Keep hard-constraint types aligned with the permit list

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A site with a complete constraint list saves the extract and the capacity sum. The judgement and the walk stay. The low case is a site nobody has walked.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze floodplain drainage, erosion, banks and bridges.

steps.what: Assemble floodplain levels and storm records.

loop.output: Flood basis: level, date and storm depth
loop.check: Engineer checks each level against the survey
loop.stop: One pass; a level without a date is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Flood files mix maps and tables

steps.what: Model floodplain drainage levels and velocities.
Inspect erosion and the river banks on site.
Design repairs for eroding river banks and streams.
Check the bridges against the floodplain water level.
Civil engineer reviews the bridges and banks.
Issue the drainage measures for the floodplain.

loop.input: Repair sketch, opening check and bank notes
loop.output: Drainage issue naming the measure and the flood level used
loop.check: Engineer checks the flood level against the results
loop.stop: One draft; a measure not in the sketch is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue must match the bank that was inspected

tasks.design: Flood levels are read into a basis and the drainage model returns level and velocity. The engineer still inspects erosion and the banks, and draws the repair. Bridge openings are checked as numbers, then a civil engineer reviews them. The issue follows the inspected bank, not only the model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Flood levels were retyped and the bank was sometimes inspected only after the drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: The model run can start from a level table. The inspection and the repair drawing stay.
tasks.still_hard: A bank that the model shows as stable and the site shows as already failing.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer has stood on the bank and will not issue a repair for the wrong mechanism.
tasks.altitude: Bank inspections stay. The engineer can refuse a drainage issue that is not tied to a flood result and a site note.

reach.task: Check a bridge opening and its foundations
reach.learn: Which openings the water level may not be allowed to use

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
A flood model returns levels; it does not inspect a bank or design the repair.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from flood records to the issued drainage measures. Structural design of the bridge is the civil engineer's work.
Test the model's native inputs before custom code.
Structured fields are flood level, date, storm depth, velocity and opening size. The survey produces levels. Fallback: the engineer types a level from the inspection and marks it as a site reading.
Inspecting banks and streams is physical work.
unknowns: Whether the flood model is already calibrated.
Who is responsible for the bridge structure.
research_questions: Which banks need a geotechnical opinion before a repair is drawn?

already_counted.description: Checking the issue against the flood results and bank notes

incremental.description: Keep storm and roughness assumptions aligned with the flood model

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A calibrated model with a level table saves the basis extract and part of the run. Inspection, repair design and the bridge review stay. The low case is an uncalibrated floodplain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Cost comparisons, agency answers, feasibility walks and bank inspections stay. Price extensions and record lookups take less of the week.
reach: Civil engineers on quantities and bridge openings
Architects on site constraints shared with a building
skills_to_grow: Stopping a scheme when cost beats a credible benefit
Sending an agency only a figure the record holds
Returning infeasible before a full study is staffed
role.ambitious_version: The engineer can stop a weak scheme or an ungrounded agency figure earlier, and still walks the site before calling it feasible.
